title: Stripe ribbon
description: A flowing ribbon of light made of dozens of thin strokes, shading from sky blue through orange and pink to violet with a fine fibrous sheen. Sweeps from the top centre to the right edge, or fans up from the bottom like stage light. Drifts slowly.
notes: colours come from chart-1, chart-2, chart-3 and chart-5: themes with muted chart colours give a muted ribbon
pure SVG + a CSS drift; no canvas or JavaScript, renders in static HTML
